newsitem.title: USA: Dun & Bradstreet Corp Q3 shr decreases.
newsitem.headline: Dun & Bradstreet Corp Q3 shr decreases.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE - First Call mean estimate for Q3 was $0.92 per share

1996 Q3 results include a one-time, pre-tax charge of $26.8 million related to reorganization costs, a $3.5 million loss from sale of the Southern California proprietary directory operation and a $4.4 million loss from divestiture of American Credit Indemnity.
Q3 1996 also includes an after-tax charge of $64.6 million related to the planned divestiture of Dun & Bradstreet Software and Gartner Group's acquisition of J3 Learning Corp.
The period also includes an after-tax charge of $58.5 million related to post-employment benefits expenses and restructuring costs.
Results also include a $90 million gain from the sale of Interactive Data Corp. The 1996 quarter also includes a one-time $3 million tax charge related to the company's reorganization.
